age.name: THESIS - Egg Candling, version 6
age.species: unknown; do not describe results as duck performance
age.label_limitations: Object-detection annotations require box audit and crop extraction before classification. Species, unique egg identity, timestamps, and outcome ground truth are undocumented. Source day names are not independently verified incubation ages. Version 6 has no listed augmentation.

pat.name: Pat - Balut Eggs Project, version 8
pat.species: balut/duck-labelled public source; no independent species verification
pat.label_limitations: Source-specific auxiliary classification only. Reject has no published biological confirmation procedure and is not automatically rotten or the operational REJECT_SUSPECT class. Fertilized and Unfertilized retain original meanings; neither is mapped to Day 16/18. Age, physical egg IDs, and outcome ground truth are unavailable. Multi-egg frames require source-labelled bounding-box crops; preserve image families across splits.

limitations: Day labels come from a species-unverified public source; chronological age is not independently confirmed.
Reject examples come from a different public dataset than age examples. Source appearance is confounded with Reject and may inflate mixed-source results.
No physical egg/session identities are available. Public image grouping cannot establish independent eggs.
Reject retains the original source label; other Pat labels are excluded and are not relabelled as Reject or assigned an age.
No mandatory human review in image analysis. Uncertain inputs request another image; physical sorting and food-safety authority remain unavailable.
Recapture thresholds were fitted to development data; accepted predictions can still be wrong. Coverage must be reported with accuracy.
output_semantics: Uncalibrated decision scores and normalized feature vector; unclear images remain unclassified with automatic recapture request.
